name: HE BEAT HER.
source:
He beat her.

That’s what everyone thinks.

But you might find otherwise...if you pick the right move.

You’re a lawyer, and your client is being accused of abuse. You only have 5 minutes until the verdict.

You’re practically powerless.

What will you do in those minutes? And can your actions make a difference?

Find the truth. Serve justice.

[Edited from [url=https://zephyo.itch.io/he-beat-her]itch.io[/url]]

Created for Ludum Dare #39 (theme: "Running out of Power").
translation:
他打了她。

所有人都是这么认为的。

但只要选对行动，你也许会发现事实并非如此……

你是一名律师，你的客户被控虐待。距离宣判只剩5分钟。

你几乎无能为力。

在这几分钟里，你会怎么做？你的行动能带来改变吗？

找出真相，伸张正义。

[据[url=https://zephyo.itch.io/he-beat-her]itch.io[/url]编辑]

本作为Ludum Dare#39（主题：“力量即将耗尽”）制作。
